name: 28137 · Richfield, NC
findings: ZIP 28137 (Richfield) has 8 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (75%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28137 (Richfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
